title: Dimension Door
author: Dark Sun Engine
description: A new psychokinetic science for psionicists: Dimension Door. The psionicist vanishes and reappears on a free spot in sight up to 10 squares away, as the whole of its turn; no one it leaves behind gets a blow at it. 4 PSPs, a Constitution check at -1. It uses Displacement's icon and Blink's look. Off: the game has only the original's powers.
